files.title: File:United Methodist Church of Batavia (5998650149).jpg
files.author: Teemu008 from Palatine, Illinois
files.caption: United Methodist Church of Batavia (1887). It was built by Solon Spencer Beman, who is best known for designing the planned community of Pullman, Chicago. The exterior was built from local boulders, and the church replaced the First Methodist Church of Batavia.
